system.longDesc:
Source: Biology. Cost: 2 EN.

Your overactive adrenal glands cause a surge in times of stress. You can perform the Adrenaline Rush stunt for –1 SP cost and gain access to a special Adrenaline Surge stunt that grants you a Force Multiplier on your Strength (Might) tests: ×2 for 2 SP, ×5 for 4 SP, and ×10 for 6 SP.
